title: RailRaised
description: The payload of task.rail_raised/v1 (M1 slice plan P17a, P17b): an operator raised one of a task's rails, for that task, above the cap then in force: a count rail's to, or per_task_usd's to_usd. internal/authority admits it only under its task's id, by its actor, at its event's time, with exactly the cap its rail takes, above the cap in force.
